overall_quality.evidence: A deadlock occurs when two or more processes are blocked forever, waiting for each other to release resources. To prevent deadlocks, ensure that processes acquire all necessary resources before starting work, and release them immediately after use. Use a priority-based system to avoid circular waits, and implement timeouts to break potential deadlocks.
